test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**There is an underlined segment in the given sentence. Select the most appropriate option to substitute the segment. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

The Covid-19 pandemic has stopped people __from venturing out__ unless it is necessary.
solution:
The correct answer is: No substitution

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• "Venturing out" means to risk going somewhere or doing something that might be dangerous or unpleasant, or to risk saying something that might be criticized.
 
• We use '**from**' to refer to the place where someone or something starts or originates.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "**People no longer go outside unless absolutely essential because of the Covid-19 epidemic.**"
 
• The given sentence is written in the Present perfect tense, which has the following structure: 
 
 
• **Subject + have/has + past participle + the rest of the sentence.__**
 
 
 
• Therefore, the given sentence is both grammatically and conceptually correct.

​Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
